name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Agentic AI Operator · Automation & Productivity Specialist
summary: Agentic operator and automation specialist building autonomous, AI-driven workflows that execute real work. I break manual business processes into agent architectures, translate loosely-formed stakeholder intent into precise prompts and agent logic, and build the evaluation loops that keep outputs reliable. Fifteen-plus years in business and marketing operations underneath it, so the automation is grounded in how work actually gets done, and documented clearly enough for other people to adopt.

Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions, acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.

Built and documented 20+ end-to-end automation workflows and an audit/outreach agent that enrolled 180+ contacts, writing best practices clear enough for others to replicate.
